selection: Shuffle unique queries; first test, then dev, then eligible training queries. All known positives retained; fill corpora with original judged negatives. Training excludes held-out corpus text and known cross-query positive collisions. Optional training negatives use original order, excluding all known training positives and held-out corpus text; no model-based mining.
limitations: Custom public dev split; base pretraining overlap and semantic near-duplicates not excluded; relevance labels may be incomplete; not an official benchmark.
